Location: FKiSS Events > never

Event: Never()

Related Events: initialize, begin, end, overflow
See also: FKiSS, Events, Actions

never()

First defined in: FKiSS1b
The never event is never called.
Use this event to temporarily block segments of FKiSS code while developing your artform. It is also useful for defining special behavior on KiSS viewers too old for some new event.
There can be any number of never events but none of them will ever be activated.

Example:

;@ never()
;@   notify("The user will never see this message.")

;@ initialize()
;@   gosub(1)
;@ never()
;@ label(1)
;@   unmap("warning.cel")
